evidence: Selecting API module filter reduced list to only API docs; selecting All restored full list of all modules.
Selecting REST API Design Guidelines showed title, description, date 2024-01-15, version v2.3.0, content sections, and related documents list.

Clicking expanded reference link 'HTTP Methods Guide' navigated the document view to that document; clicking related doc reference from Method Semantics section navigated back to REST API Design Guidelines.
Collapsing REST Principles section hid the paragraph body and expanded (interactive) reference links, leaving the section header still clickable to reopen.
Re-expanding REST Principles restored the paragraph body and its two reference links (API Versioning Strategy, Error Handling Standards).
Chevron icon has rotate-180 class when section expanded (body visible) and no rotation class when collapsed (body hidden), consistent across all sampled sections.

Clicking 'HTTP Methods Guide' link in collapsed 'Endpoint Naming Conventions' section kept current doc open and showed toast 'Please expand the section to access links'. After expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to HTTP Methods Guide document.
REST API Design Guidelines and HTTP Methods Guide documents both omit themselves from their own content-section references and related-documents lists.
Clicking Rate Limiting node added glow ring (r=28, animate-pulse-glow) and thicker stroke; Zoom In increased indicator from 100% to 120%; Reset View returned indicator to 100%.
Graph shows 19 nodes matching the 19 total documents across all modules; SVG contains 19 connecting lines; Reset View control fits/centers the whole graph at 100%.
Each of the 19 document nodes is colored per its module (colors match the 5-module legend: API, Authentication, Data Layer, UI Components, Core System) and 19 lines connect related documents.
Header nav exposes Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites buttons; clicking each switches the active view (active state toggles on the clicked button) and renders the corresponding content.

Selected doc Database Schema Design with Naming Conventions collapsed / Indexing Strategy expanded and graph zoom at 120% were both preserved after cycling through Knowledge Graph → Favorites → Knowledge Graph → Documents.

issue: Graph node click does not open document view
actual: Clicking a knowledge-graph node (e.g. Rate Limiting, Database Schema Design) only visually selects the node (glow highlight) and silently updates the underlying selected document; the app remains on the Knowledge Graph tab. The user must manually click the 'Documents' tab button to see the opened document, so choosing a node does not open the document view without a separate tab change as required.

issue: Favorites view is filtered by the Documents module filter
actual: Favorites persisted after reload (count stayed at 2) and favorite markers survived filtering/sorting in Documents. However, when the Documents view had the DATA module filter active and the user switched to Favorites, only the Data Layer favorite (Database Schema Design) was shown while the API favorite (Rate Limiting) was hidden, despite the favorites counter still showing 2. Resetting the Documents filter to All restored both favorites in the Favorites view. This violates the requirement that Favorites must expose every favorited document regardless of the module filter used in Documents.

evidence: Typing "zzznonexistentquery" into search box produced "No documents found" / "Try adjusting your search or filter criteria" message with document list hidden. Clearing the search box restored the full list of 19 documents.
